name: personal-space
description: Personal Space - a private, single-user personal knowledge manager

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace=server && npm run test:coverage --workspace=client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
